status: temporary default (owner decision 2026-11-01); experimental, not validated for general use
selection_criterion: clean_degraded_mean validation ROC-AUC (pre-declared rule, Celeb-DF candidates)
trained_on: DeepFakeFace sample + Celeb-DF v2 crops (41 training identities), quality augmentation; identity-disjoint splits
limitations: Weaker than v2 on AI-edited and text-to-image faces (see docs/CURRENT_DEFAULT_MODEL.md). Scores are uncalibrated. Celeb-DF video accuracy is within-dataset only.
